title: 1RB0LB_1RC0LA_1LB0RD_1RE1RD_1RB1RF_1LA--- and its twin: the sweeps on digit lists, and no halt reduced to a closed set of digit lists
text: The 26 sweep theorems of lean/Stops.lean, cut into digits, give 76 rules on lists of digits (lean/Dsweep.lean); Lean checks every cut, and the relation they form is a run of the machine from sample to sample. no_halt_of_closed turns any set of digit lists that holds a sample reached from blank and is kept by the rules into a proof of no halt. The rules agree with 1,424,000 exact sweeps of the long run. Still open: that set, and rules for the carries that reach the right end of the tape.
